bead.title: bench-pr-A2: bash runner core — dispatch, listing/validate/preflight, --plan, matrix expansion
bead.description:
PROBLEM: fiz-bench matrix (cmd/bench/matrix.go, ~2244 LOC) is the only way to enumerate and run the matrix; it requires host Python and Go. We need a single bash entrypoint scripts/benchmark/benchmark that parses args, lists config, validates, runs preflight (image rebuild), and prints the matrix under --plan with zero side effects.

ROOT CAUSE: matrix orchestration (profile/bench-set parsing, profile x task x rep expansion) lives in Go at cmd/bench/matrix.go and is dispatched from cmd/bench/main.go:40 (case "matrix"); there is no shell equivalent and no pure --plan path.

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark):
- Dispatch: ./benchmark <subcommand> with subcommands profiles | bench-sets | task-executors | harness-adapters | validate | preflight; no subcommand = run mode.
- Run-mode flags: --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...] [--plan] [--force-rerun] [--retry-invalid] [--reps N] [--jobs N] [--max-cost-usd X] [--out DIR]. --profile and --bench-set are both required for --plan and run.
- Read profile/bench-set/concurrency-group YAML via yq -o=json.
- Matrix expansion: profile x task x rep -> ordered cell list; resolve tasks_from: references (path relative to the bench-set file) AND inline tasks: lists; default task_executor=harbor when framework==terminal-bench (PR C finalizes the schema).
- preflight: rebuild the harbor-runner image (invokes A1 build-harbor-runner.sh) when the cached image label != current content sha.
- --plan: validate + print the matrix; NO file writes, NO Docker pulls/builds.

NON-SCOPE: per-cell execution/result/report compose (A3); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); adapters/image/runtime-probe (A1); Go changes/parity/deactivation (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor schema finalization (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: depends on A1 (preflight invokes build-harbor-runner.sh; matrix default executor=harbor). Parent fizeau-163efede. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --plan --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary prints the matrix, creates NO files, and builds NO Docker images. (parent AC1) Test: Test_PlanIsPure, Test_PlanPrintsMatrix (scripts/benchmark/tests/plan.bats).
2. ./benchmark profiles and ./benchmark bench-sets list config parsed from YAML. Test: Test_ListingSubcommands (plan.bats).
3. ./benchmark validate exits non-zero on a malformed profile/bench-set and zero on the canary. Test: Test_Validate (plan.bats).
4. Matrix expansion resolves both tasks_from: and inline tasks: and orders profile x task x rep. Test: Test_MatrixExpansion (scripts/benchmark/tests/matrix.bats).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: Runner-core ACs 1-4 pass, including parent AC1 (--plan purity); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
